phases.1: Reconcile source inventory, obligations and unsupported syntax; no semantic certification
phases.2: Core expressions, ordering, pagination, relational and set semantics
phases.3: Functions, collections, Unicode, temporal and type semantics
phases.4: Negative, boundary, adversarial and interaction tests
phases.5: Python/Rust, optimiser and platform differential verification
phases.6: Evidence reconciliation and final certification gate

certification_rule: Every applicable dimension requires independently reviewed case evidence or an explicit reviewed not-applicable reason; tagged legacy tests and generated outputs are not proof.
